name: knext-vinext-node-fixture
description: Minimal vinext app used ONLY by vinext-node-image.docker-e2e.test.ts. The suite renders the SHIPPED scaffold templates (vite.config.ts, knext-node-entry.mjs, runtime-contract.mjs, Dockerfile.vinext-node) over it, so what is proved is the template, not a copy. srvx is deliberately NOT declared here: the e2e copies it from the rendered kn-next create package.json and installs with an isolated linker, so an undeclared template dependency fails the build. NOT a workspace member; its deps are installed into a throwaway build dir by the e2e, and @getknext/core is linked to this checkout's built package there.
